morgan: FYI eu-west1 embeddings spiked 503s since 21:50 UTC. I have a small restartless hotfix branch to fix a KV eviction race. Requesting expedited approval for a short change window 22:05-22:25 UTC.

deploy-bot: /deploy request created repo=rl-inference ref=hotfix/kv-evict-1.2.4 env=eu-west1 strategy=restartless-canary ID=DBOT-10077.

tia: Ops needs runbook + rollback steps and gating thresholds before approval.

sre-oncall: Risk: low functional change. Operational: cache warmup can bump p99 briefly. Rollback: pin to v1.2.2 and run forced-clear job. Fallback triggers: errors >2.5% for 5m OR p99 >850ms for 5m.

emily: Canary plan: 0.5% for 10m -> 5% for 10m -> promote. Auto-fallback on triggers.

release-manager: Draft note: "hotfix(embeddings): fix intermittent 503s in eu-west1 due to KV eviction race (v1.2.4)". Will publish after deploy.

morgan: Runbook + dashboards: https://runbooks/kv-evict-hotfix and https://dash/embeddings?region=eu-west1. Rollback command: `kubectl run clear-kv --image=ops/kvclear:stable --env=eu-west1`.

tia: Runbook validated. Monitoring hooks and PD escalation confirmed.

alex: Product approved. :white_check_mark:

platform-ops: Standby to pin traffic or reroute.

deploy-bot: T-minus 3m. Any objections?
morgan: none. proceed.
deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-10077 rolling 0.5% canary.
deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (5m): errors 0.3% (baseline 0.15%), p99 +80ms. Within gates.

sre-oncall: No new stack traces. monitoring OK.
deploy-bot: PROMOTED to 5% -> observing 10m.
emily: metrics stable, no customer reports.
sre-oncall: p99 trending down, errors ~0.6%. safe to finish after timer.
deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.4 at 100% in eu-west1. No fallback triggered. Audit: https://deploys/dbot/10077/audit

release-manager: Changelog published and support notified. Tag v1.2.4.
morgan: Thanks all, closing thread.
alex: quick turnaround, nice. :tada:
sre-oncall: Closing monitoring loop, will reopen if issues arise."
